row: F41#8 (5.92): Stormwood named villagers' faces clip to white (Elder Maud, Rodkeeper Hesk, Warden-elect Bryn)
capture_both: base (overlay off) and arm (overlay on), same command as G-below6-namedposts
_why: G-below6-namedposts 3/3: 'speakers' faces burn orange-white'. On CPU, emission floor 0 and rim 0.2 both left the faces white, so the cause is the storm light on pale skin and hair. Arm: each of the three bodies' albedo is multiplied by a neutral grey (Maud #a8a8a8, Hesk and Bryn #b0b0b0). No light, emission or texture change.
rides_along_on_both_sides: Hesk's dialogue portrait is now the installed alpha_tracker plate (sorrel.png, a bearded man in a hat) instead of villager_male (the dark-haired boy). This is a direct data fix in stormwood_dialogue_presentation.json plates_by_profile, so it shows on base and arm alike.
want_to_see: skin tone and readable features on all three faces, Maud's hair off-white instead of a white ball; say if the bodies now read muddy or too dark against the ground (the tints are config).
note: The player's own bloom is not touched here.
